texts.preamble: Dr V Shivegowda vs State Of Karnataka on 30 September, 2025 Author: Suraj Govindaraj Bench: Suraj Govindaraj -1- Nc: 2025:Khc:39351-Db Wp No. 30045 of 2025 Hc-Kar In The High Court Of Karnataka At Bengaluru Dated This The 30Th Day Of September, 2025 Present The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Suraj Govindaraj And The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Rai K Writ Petition No. 30045 Of 2025 (S-Ksat) Between: 1. Dr. V.Shivegowda S / O Sri R T Venkategowda, Aged About 54 Years, Working As General Duty Medical Officer, On Deputation And Working As Designated Officer Bbmp East Zone, Kr Circle, Bengaluru R/At Sri Sai Uday Mohan Apartment, 6Th Main, F-3, 2Nd Floor, Appareddypalya Digitally signed by Shwetha Indiranagar Raghavendra Bengaluru - 560038 Location: High ...Petitioner Court Of Karnataka (By Sri. By Its Principal Secretary Health And Family Welfare Services Department, Vikasa Soudha Bengaluru - 560001. -2- Nc: 2025:Khc:39351-Db Wp No. 30045 of 2025 Hc-Kar 2. The Commissioner Health And Family Welfare Services Department, Arogya Soudha Magadi Road, Bengaluru - 560023 3. The Commissioner Food Safety And Standards Authority Public Health Institute Premises, Seshadri Road, Bengaluru - 560001. ...Respondents (By Sri.Reuben Jacob, Aag A/W Smt.Navya Shekar, Aga) This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Article 226 Of The Constitution Of India Praying To Set Side The Impugned Interim Order
texts.facts: The petitioner, who belongs of Department of Health and Family Welfare Services, was deputed to work as Designated Officer as Food Safety Officer under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'the Act') in BBMP East Zone, K.R.Circle vide order dated 03.09.2024 for a period of one year. 3. Alleging that the petitioner has been prematurely repatriated vide order dated 07.05.2025, the petitioner had approached the Karnataka Appellate Tribunal.
texts.arguments: The submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that the petitioner is required to be granted the benefit of continuity of service and protection against the transfer on the ground the deputation has to be for minimum five years. 5. Learned Additional Advocate General submits that a policy decision having been taken, the Sub-Divisional Officer has been designated as the officer under the Act and as such, the Health Officers, who had been deputed have been repatriated. The policy decision having been so taken, the petitioner cannot claim any benefit. 6. The submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that the deputation could have been only for a period of five years in terms of the order dated 16.07.1983 at Annexure-A1 and there could be no delegation for a period lesser than five years.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that the petitioner is required to be granted the benefit of continuity of service and protection against the transfer on the ground the deputation has to be for minimum five years. 5. Learned Additional Advocate General submits that a policy decision having been taken, the Sub-Divisional Officer has been designated as the officer under the Act and as such, the Health Officers, who had been deputed have been repatriated. The policy decision having been so taken, the petitioner cannot claim any benefit. 6. The submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that the deputation could have been only for a period of five years in terms of the order dated 16.07.1983 at Annexure-A1 and there could be no delegation for a period lesser than five years.
